messages:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout: service=triton-proxy version=3.2.0 -> target 20% global (eu-west=8%, us-west=7%, ap-south=5%). change-window=2024-11-12T03:00Z. :rocket:
ivy: watching p50/p95/p99 and 5xx dashboards.
drew: small p99 surge in us-west ~1m after start; 5xx 1.9% -> 4.5%. grabbing logs.
ops-oncall: paste a sample error pls.
drew: sample: `grpc: stream error: code=13 desc="protocol error: keepalive mismatch"`
anita: release diff mentioned keepalive default bump in 3.2.0. might hit older transit proxies that close streams.
ops-oncall: recommend PAUSE rollout and regional pin for us-west to 3.1.8 while we confirm scope.
deploy-bot: rollout status: 20% deployed. to pause run: `/deploy pause --id=1768809999`
ops-oncall: running pause now...
ops-oncall: `/deploy pause --id=1768809999` -> accepted. applying route override for us-west.
deploy-bot: action: route override applied. us-west traffic pinned to version=3.1.8 (7%). health-check endpoints returning 200.
ivy: confirming metrics: us-west 5xx dropping to baseline within 45s.
release-eng: note: "hotfix required: grpc keepalive incompatibility in triton-proxy v3.2.0; us-west pinned to 3.1.8 while we investigate."
drew: will open hotfix to add defensive keepalive fallback and add a proxy integration test. propose 1% us-west canary + 30m monitoring post-fix.
ops-oncall: ack. prefer pin + fix over global rollback. will escalate if noise returns. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout paused by ops-oncall. current global deployed fraction: 13% (us-west pinned to 3.1.8).
